comparisonPolicy.measured: source reading minus its own series black plus the dedicated Summary black
comparisonPolicy.sourceCoordinate: ordered source index normalized from zero to one; no missing R code or extra G code identity is invented
comparisonPolicy.upstreamComparison: exact pinned Shader equation without measured black; reported as a regression fixture, not a fair absolute-reflectance candidate

upstreamAbsoluteComparison.policy: component-wise map the upstream normalized white to the black-subtracted measured Greyscale endpoint, then add the project's dedicated measured black

heldOutGrayComparison.policy: pairwise uses R/G/B plus Y/C/M and does not use Greyscale; pairwise-neutral then adds the measured Greyscale residual; runtime-monotonic-lut applies the declared global 3D luminance projection
